audit.whatIsWrong: Three rows disagreed between layers: phases[4..6].side read Skill/Skill/Skill while win[4..6] read Zoe/Aurelion Sol/Aurelion Sol.
audit.why: At 47.89% over 380 games Zoe wins the lane. Level 6 is hers, not even — Portal Jump comes back every 11 seconds at rank 1 while Falling Star is on 120. The first-item stage is the genuine wash, and only two items is clearly Aurelion Sol's.
audit.corrected: Zoe / Zoe / Zoe / Zoe / Zoe / Skill / Aurelion Sol, proposed as matched pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes and prose referenced 'Starsurge', 'Comet', 'Sleepless bubble', and repeatedly told the player to land a stun before level 6.
audit.why: Aurelion Sol's only stun is Falling Star at 6; nothing in his kit stuns before that, so 'she can burst you down before you ever land a stun' at levels 3-5 describes a tool the player does not have. Zoe's E is Sleepy Trouble Bubble, not 'sleepless bubble'.
audit.corrected: Spikes rebuilt on Paddle Star (8.5s, 800 range, redirects in flight), Sleepy Trouble Bubble (18/17/16/15/14s) and Portal Jump (11/8/5s, 575 range, blinks back).

audit.whatIsWrong: The channel-cancel interaction and Paddle Star's in-flight redirect were both absent, and Portal Jump was described as a roaming tool.
audit.why: Sleepy Trouble Bubble is Zoe's only hard CC and is therefore the only thing in her kit that cancels Breath of Light or Astral Flight — and the sleep doubles the first source of damage that breaks it, which is what turns a bubble into a kill. Paddle Star can be redirected mid-flight, so sidestepping does not reliably save the channel. Portal Jump blinks 575 units for one second and then blinks back: it is a combo and dodge tool, not a roam. Her roaming comes from Spell Thief picking up spent summoner spells.
audit.corrected: Written into spikes[0], spikes[1], early, mid, breakdown.cooldowns, whys[2], whys[4], wants.foe[2] and dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: The brief suggests Sleepy Trouble Bubble creates terrain that cuts your retreat, and that it bypasses resistances as true damage.
audit.why: Riot's own description says only that the target becomes drowsy then sleeps, that sleep reduces Magic Resist, and that the breaking hit is doubled up to a cap. It says nothing about terrain or true damage, so both derived flags look like tooltip-parsing misfires.
audit.corrected: Asserted the MR shred and the doubled breaking hit, which Riot states; asserted nothing about terrain or true damage.

edits.before: Zoe's Paddle Star chip damage and hidden sleepy-bubble angles from brush punish you before your Starsurge windup can threaten her back, and if she lands a bubble she can combo you down fast. Levels 1-5 you need to respect bush vision and side-step predictable bubble throws, playing for safe CS rather than trades.
edits.after: Paddle Star chips you from 800 units and redirects in flight, and her bubble angles come out of brush — a landed Sleepy Trouble Bubble ends your channel, shreds your MR and doubles her next hit. Levels 1-5 respect bush vision and never start the beam while her E is up, playing for safe CS rather than trades.

edits.before: Level 6 raises the stakes — Portal Jump lets her reposition mid-combo for extra burst or a clean escape, so a landed sleepy bubble on you can end in a kill before you get a single stun off. Ward key bush entrances, avoid standing in bubble-flight lines, and don't commit Comet unless she's already used her mobility.
edits.after: Level 6 raises the stakes — Portal Jump blinks her 575 units and back on an 11-second cooldown at rank 1, so a landed bubble can end in a kill while she is untouchable in the middle of it. Ward the bush entrances, stay out of Paddle Star's flight lines, and hold Falling Star until her E is spent.

edits.after: Your first item finally gives you the health and Falling Star uptime to punish her whenever she oversteps for a bubble, since Portal Jump takes her 575 units and puts her straight back. From there your uncapped Stardust and The Skies Descend outclass her all-in burst kit in extended fights — group up, force stand-offs, and let your ceiling win.
